label: EnGenius ECS2512 (8x 2.5G, 4x SFP+, no PoE)
description: EnGenius Cloud ECS2512 layer 2+ multi-gigabit switch: 8x 100/1000/2500BASE-T RJ45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 120 Gbps switching capacity, 16K MAC, no PoE, 13-inch 1U.

fabric.note: Vendor figure 120 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of 8x 2.5G plus 4x 10G (60 Gbit/s of line rate x 2).

notes: Ports 1-8 are 100/1000/2500BASE-T (802.3bz NBase-T over existing Cat5e/Cat6, auto-negotiating 100M/1G/2.5G), the four SFP+ cages take 100/1000/10,000 Mbps optics. No PoE: no PSE port and no budget published for this SKU. 16K MAC, 512 KB packet buffer, 330 x 230 x 44 mm, 2.6 kg, 13-inch 1U, 23.52 W full load. RJ45 console port. Management is EnGenius Cloud (zero-touch provisioning), the local web GUI (HTTP/HTTPS over IPv4 and IPv6) and a CLI reached over SSH/Telnet/TFTP config backup; SNMP v1/v2c/v3 with RMON 1,2,3,9 is supported. Layer 3 is static routing only: 63 IPv4 and 21 IPv6 static routes, a 192-entry ARP table and up to 20 IPv6 addresses on the box - no OSPF and no BGP, which is why this is modelled as l3-forward without a routing engine. L2 set: 802.1D/w/s spanning tree, 802.1Q tagging with port-based and protocol-based VLANs, 802.3ad link aggregation, IGMP and MLD snooping, voice VLAN, 802.1X with RADIUS, MAC/IP ACLs and storm control, 8 QoS queues. Operating 0-50 C, 5-95% RH non-condensing, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz, 2-year warranty. Firmware: the ECS15XX-25XX image is shared across the ECS15xx and ECS25xx classes - the download table on the model pages lists ECS15XX-25XX_firmware_1.2.136-197.imag dated 16 July 2026 as the current build, with 1.2.130-193 (27 May 2026) and 1.2.125-192 (12 February 2026) beneath it. Sources: https://www.engeniustech.com/eu/products/network-switches/ecs2512/ (comparison table: 8 x 2.5G, 4x SFP+, no PoE, 120 Gbps, 16K MAC, 13-inch 1U, 23.52 W) and https://www.engeniustech.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/Cloud-Switches-DS-09-29-20.pdf.
